text:
brian: Heads-up: UX wants copy for the node eviction confirmation when an admin removes an on-prem/private node. Current dialog is too terse: "Remove node?" with "Remove" and "Cancel". Ops flagged potential data loss/evacuation confusion.
tayla: Agree. Need to clearly convey that workloads will be drained, running requests will be routed elsewhere, and stored logs/metrics might remain on the node until retention runs. Avoid legalese but be explicit about immediate vs delayed effects.
mohit: Draft microcopy idea: heading: "Remove node from pool" body: "This will remove the selected node from the Private deployment pool. Active workloads will be drained and routed to other nodes. Data stored only on this node (logs, local caches) may remain until retention or manual cleanup." caveat (small): "This action is irreversible. Eviction may temporarily increase latency for in-flight requests."
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: the dialog must use role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby IDs. Keep the main body under 300 chars. Use plain language and avoid passive voice. Provide a clear focus order: primary CTA last-focused.
brian: Wording nit: users often panic at "irreversible". Can we soften to "cannot be undone from the UI" and point to a recovery doc?
mohit: Revised caveat: "This change cannot be undone from the Console. See recovery options in documentation." Add a link to the recovery doc in the modal.
tayla: CTA suggestions: Primary: "Remove node" (danger style), Secondary: "Cancel". Also include a tertiary text link: "Drain and test first" which opens a pre-eviction checklist or runbook.
brian: For telemetry we need a one-line audit note in the footer: "Action will be recorded in the Audit Log" with an info icon that shows a tooltip: "Admins can review node removals in Settings > Audit Log." Keep audit text unobtrusive.
a11y-bot: Tooltip must be keyboard accessible and referenceable by aria-describedby; ensure info icon has aria-label.
legal-bot: Quick legal flag: avoid promising behavior (e.g., "no data loss"). Add a short clarification: "Depending on your storage configuration, some data may be accessible only on the node until replicated or purged." Keep it under a single sentence.
mohit: Final proposed copy blob:
```
Heading: Remove node from deployment
Body: Removing this node will drain active workloads and remove it from the Private deployment pool. Requests will be routed to other nodes; in-flight requests may see temporary latency changes. Data stored only on this node (local logs or caches) may remain until retention or manual cleanup.
Caveat (small): "This change cannot be undone from the Console. See recovery options in documentation."
Primary CTA: Remove node
Secondary CTA: Cancel
Tertiary link: Drain and test first
Footer note: Action will be recorded in the Audit Log
```
brian: Looks good. Mohit, add i18n keys: `node.remove.heading`, `.body`, `.caveat`, `.cta_confirm`, `.cta_cancel`, `.link_drain`, `.audit_note`. Use placeholders for the node name.
tayla: Also request a short confirmation step for high-risk nodes: a checkbox "I understand this will remove the node from the pool" that enables the Remove button. Only show the checkbox when the node hosts critical roles.
a11y-bot: If checkbox is used, ensure it's focusable and has aria-required if needed. Announce enabling of the primary CTA via aria-live when checkbox toggles.
brian: I'll post the updated Figma modal with copy + the runbook link. Quick copy QA after that. Thanks! :shipit:
